mcpCatalog.name: get_payment_link_details
mcpCatalog.description: Get the status and details of a payment link by its opaque Link ID (data.id from create — not the merchant ref, not the URL slug).

mcpCatalog.name: query_journal
mcpCatalog.description: Query the local transaction journal (no network): the chronological timeline of one transaction, aggregate stats (latency/retries/errors/funnel), reconcile creations vs webhook callbacks, or detect anomalies. Only knows what was journaled while recording was on.

mcpCatalog.name: query_knowledge
mcpCatalog.description: Search or read the built-in PayWay knowledge base offline (no network): integration guides, gateway error-code hints, and sandbox-verified lessons for web checkout, QR, callbacks/webhooks, payment links, COF, pre-auth, payouts, and deployment. Prefer this over guessing gateway behavior.

mcpCatalog.name: check_transaction
mcpCatalog.description: Check the status of a transaction by its transaction id.

mcpCatalog.name: check_transaction_by_merchant_ref
mcpCatalog.description: Check a transaction using the merchant reference.

mcpCatalog.name: poll_transaction
mcpCatalog.description: Poll a transaction until it reaches a terminal state or times out.

mcpCatalog.name: save_artifact
mcpCatalog.description: Persist a generated artifact (QR string, content, etc.) to disk/session.

mcpCatalog.name: open_artifact
mcpCatalog.description: Open a previously saved artifact or an explicit HTTPS URL.

mcpCatalog.name: copy_to_clipboard
mcpCatalog.description: Copy text to the system clipboard.

mcpCatalog.name: list_transactions
mcpCatalog.description: List transactions in a time window via the PayWay gateway. Dates are GATEWAY time UTC+7 — a UTC/local-derived window silently returns 0 rows. Max window 3 days, page size ≤1000; defaults to the current gateway day. Read-only.

mcpCatalog.name: journal_stats
mcpCatalog.description: Local transaction-journal statistics (latency, retries, errors, funnel) recorded by the CLI/SDK while journaling was enabled. No network call. Read-only.

mcpCatalog.name: journal_timeline
mcpCatalog.description: Reconstruct one transaction from the local transaction journal: chronological digest events plus an RCA verdict/steps/hints. Digest projection only — request/response bodies never leave the machine. No network call. Read-only.
